title: netdevice(7) — low-level access to Linux network devices

date.notes: Current manual revision used to document surviving ioctl ABI.

claims_extracted.claim: Linux retains a socket ioctl interface based largely on struct ifreq for device flags, addresses, MTU, hardware address, interface enumeration and related configuration.
claims_extracted.notes: Current ABI survivorship evidence, not first-introduction evidence.

notes: Used to define the surviving legacy control surface that iproute2/rtnetlink did not erase.
